programmes.d: The return of Dr. Denman means trouble for the girls. Meanwhile, Emma is having family dramas of her own. With Zane’s unwitting help, Denman’s research at Mako Island uncovers the girls' secret!
Dr. Denman has discovered the girls' secret and trapped them on Mako Island. Their only chance to avoid being exposed is to use the lunar eclipse to give up their powers forever!
Under the influence of a Full Moon, the girls' powers are hugely enhanced and they wreak havoc on Lewis in his boat. The next day the girls realise they still need Lewis.
Emma uses her new powers to help Elliott win at soccer. Lewis decides to test the girls' increased powers. Cleo has had enough of Lewis' smothering and dumps him. Lewis meets Charlotte and they bond.

When Verne's techno-magic almost screws up a mission to the Centre of the Earth, Verne is humiliated and leaves the school. But Zarlak seizes the opportunity. Working through a magic artifact in Verne's backpack, he gives Verne evil powers.

UBOS and the kids return from an action packed chase in Rootopia, Center-earth, to find the school under a sleeping spell. They've saved a magical Rupunzel Plant from Zarlak and replant it in the school garden. However, there are bigger problems afoot.

On a white wintry day, Vonderland celebrates, “Festivus Solarus." Verne becomes smitten with a pretty young, visiting Spanish astrologer, who snubs him when she realizes he is a Mortie. Verne feels like a misfit in both worlds, magic and Mortie.

ELSA, a young Giantess, becomes the newest student at the school and Cassy's roommate. ZARLAK takes control over LUCREZIA'S mind through a magic gemstone. He uses her to make it look like Cassy is tormenting Elsa, who finally runs away.
Zane’s back in town and still in love with Rikki. He works out she’s still a mermaid and tries to win her back. Cleo becomes suspicious of Lewis spending time with Charlotte.
Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Nate uses Lewis to make a play for Cleo.

Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls. Cleo tries to get Don and her Mum together by using her powers to grant him a wish. Realising it’s not what he wants, she finally accepts the situation.

Cleo is worried when she sees her dad around with another woman. When she arrives at their house, she turns out to be Charlotte's mother. Meanwhile, Rikki and Emma attempt to save the Sertori's dinner with their powers.
Everyone is shocked when Cleo is fired at the Ice Cream Stand, and even more so when Lewis takes her place! Rikki and Emma strike back at him but end up going too far.
Zane has an argument with a man in a trailer park but little does he know it’s Rikki’s dad. Rikki has to overcome her shame about her background and introduce her dad to Zane.
Rene Auberjonois plays the Donald, a PR wiz who puts Eerie into a shopping spree at World O' Stuff.
After finding a TV script in his mailbox, Marshall finds himself in Hollywood, his family out of character and his name 'Omri' - who's destined to die in the script.
Marshall must save his family from the clutches of a body snatchers--like cult of kitchenware fanatics who preserve their children by sealing them into human sized tupperware.
After obtaining a retainer that allows Marshall and his friends to hear what dogs are thinking, the boys learn that the animals are planning a revolution to take over Eerie.
Thirteen year old Greg Davis hates books.
Fourteen year old Julia is obsessed with being beautiful.
Aspiring artist Ralph Philips is focused on perfecting his art.
When Eight-year-old Mary Anne moves to a new neighborhood, she meets two boys who don't know the meaning of kindness.
Sabrina wishes she had a pet. Oh, Salem’s okay as a pal, but as a loving furball, he doesn’t cut it.
There’s a dog show in Greendale. Cassandra has a stunning entry. Margaux and Tiffany are helping her train and show it.
Sabrina agrees to help Maritza with her science project but oversleeps and forgets. At the witches’ academy, Sabrina and Cassandra meet a very frank magic mirror who insults and infuriates Cassandra.
While shopping with Sabrina, Maritza ogles a necklace that Cassandra buys. Knowing how much Maritza wants it, the unkind young witch uses it to taunt Maritza.
Sabrina and Cassandra bicker their way through another potion-making assignment at the witches’ academy. Their arguing causes them to spill the entire vial of Salvia Muscaria: an extremely rare herb!
At the witches’ academy, the Sabrina and Cassandra learn about the dangers of using magic carelessly.
Hyoma challenges Gingka to a new battle and it's not like it's ever been before...
Benkei and Kenta learn how to change parts on their beys which make their beys even stronger!
Gingka and his friends go to the remote Beyblade Island to participate in the intense Survival Battle competition.
The Survival Battle continues and it's down to the wire with eight competitors remaining - who will win??
In the jaw-dropping finale of Survival Battle, everyone is surprised when Kyoya and Gingka are knocked out and the winner is - the new kid named Yu.
As the winner of the Endurance Battle, Yu is granted his wish: to have a Battle Bladers, the biggest Beyblade competition in the world.

'The Inspector's Most Wanted': A criminal from The Inspector's past seeks revenge by having him perform on the all-too-realistic Cop Patrol television show. 'Pinky Appleseed,' Pinky's efforts to re-plant a forest are obstructed by Paul Bunyan.

'Calling Dr. Panther': The Panther must save his Boss from the clutches of a mad doctor. 'For Those Who Pink Young': The Panther gets a child's view of the world when he is accidentally shrunk to kid-size by Professor Von Schmarty's fun machine.

'Lights, Camera, Voodoo': Security guard Panther comes up against an egotistical star, a demented director and an obsessive fan at a movie studio. 'I'm Dreaming of a Pink Christmas': Pinky tries to instill the spirit of Christmas in a 'scrooge.'

'Wiener Takes All': The Panther runs a successful hot dog business until the competition kidnaps the founding granny. 'The Easter Panther': When the Panther is hired to handle the White House Easter Egg Hunt, he must foil a heist by the Dogfather.

Charlie has always lived by the motto; 'There's nothing lower than a cat!', which makes his latest mission from Anabelle his greatest nightmare. Charlie and Itchy are tasked with helping a lost kitten find their way home by becoming cats themselves.
Emma meets Ash - a handsome horse riding instructor. A horse falls ill and Emma must use her powers to fix it. Lewis accidentally invites both Charlotte and Cleo to an awards dinner.
Cleo is failing at school and is assigned a tutor - Charlotte. Cleo wants Lewis back but her attitude to Charlotte only drives him further away. Cleo discovers Lewis and Charlotte kissing.
Zane hears of a treasure under the ocean and enlists the girls to find it. Rikki is injured in the search. Zane gives Rikki the reward. Charlotte contrives to keep Lewis from the girls.
Emma starts acting weird after pricking her finger on a barb of coral. Cleo’s fish Hector exhibits the same behaviour. Emma becomes more and more like a fish and Lewis has to find a way to cure her.

Don takes the family camping on Mako Island during a Full Moon. The girls are affected and need the moon pool for sanctuary. Charlotte almost slips in the moon pool and realises something weird is going on there.

Emma thinks she’s going to get a promotion at the juice bar but Ash is given the job. Emma and Ash clash over the job, but we discover it’s over a lot more. Meanwhile, Lewis stands up to Charlotte over spending time with Cleo.
Lewis and Zane find an old myth about mermaids is true – the scent of ambergris sends them wild. But it backfires when sleazy Nate gets hold of the scent and has all three mermaid girls on his arm!
Rikki tries to avoid Zane when he comes back, but needs his help after an incident with a speedboat. Meanwhile, Charlotte continues to flirt with Lewis and Cleo worries for their secret.

Cleo and Rikki push Ash into asking Emma out again – little did they know he’d turn up at Emma’s place in time for a full moon! Rikki and Cleo are both moonstruck and Ash looks set to discover Emma’s secret.
For the first anniversary of the girls being mermaids, Cleo decides to throw a party. However, Emma and Rikki fall out following a fight between Ash and Zane and Cleo may have to celebrate alone.
